title: fix: preserve search text in model filter suggestions
author: ale-rls
pr_body_excerpt:
- Preserve preceding free-text terms when projecting draft filter suggestions for Models and the shared model-query hook, so dropdown filtering and selection work after text such as `gpt publisher:`.
- Keep parent-owned base-model IDs outside draft values; shared UI stays unchanged.
- Extend the existing query regression. Original regression fails; 62 affected tests and independent actual-hook/combobox controls pass; changed-file Biome passes.
- Local full frontend typecheck/build are incomplete due to missing cached backend/build dependencies; no diagnostics target the changed source. SDK/UI prerequisite builds pass; required Enter CI will verify the full environment.

Fixes #16489

gist.headline: The words stay put
gist.blurb: Model filter suggestions keep the words you typed before them. Even `gpt publisher:` gets to finish its thought.
gist.summary: Fixed Models and the shared model-query hook to preserve preceding free-text terms when projecting draft filter suggestions, while keeping parent-owned base-model IDs out of draft values.
gist.impact: Typing `gpt publisher:` keeps `gpt` in the query, so the suggestion dropdown filters correctly and its options can be selected.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the Models search UI as a cozy retro terminal: the typed word `gpt` stays in place while a `publisher:` suggestion opens beneath it. Polli, wearing tiny librarian glasses, holds the search text steady; a small code-plant beside the terminal adds the garden motif.
